skills.detail:
Puts the character in an Electrified state. A mid-range area attack that inflicts a SPD debuff, with a chance to Shock. Become temporarily invincible after use.

Electrified State: While in an Electrified state, deals a mid-range attack with a chance to Shock. Nullifies Stagger. Grants Status Effect Nullification. Electrified state will be removed after a certain period of time.
skills.name: Give it to me!!!

skills.detail:
Begin charging by holding down the skill button. If you let go of the skill button before the charge has completed, the charge will cancel and you will attack normally. If the charge has finished, you will unleash a different attack. Attack ignores obstacles. Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time. Acquires SPD debuff effect at Level 5.

Not Charged: A mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect and an ATK debuff effect.

Charged: A long-range area attack with a Knockback effect and an ATK debuff effect.
